headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.7
summary: YouTube trailers now play inside the gallery viewer, and the content details header has a proper info block: downloads, likes, last update and all category names, filling the empty space under the buttons.

items.text: Fixed YouTube embeds not playing in the gallery viewer (DOM storage, hardware acceleration, playsinline).
The details header now shows downloads, likes, last update and all categories instead of one dense line.
